effective_text_prompt: Describe with a paragraph what is shown in the image.
content: </s><s>The image shows an office space with a desk and a computer. The desk is white and has three drawers. On the left side of the desk, there is a computer monitor and a keyboard. The computer monitor is turned on and the keyboard is resting on the desk. The chair is black and has a swivel base. The floor is carpeted and there are wires and cables scattered around the room. The walls are painted white and the overall color scheme of the space is clean and organized.</s>
